items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] A lot of people were that great, like you said, but Mel San Diego couldn't read it all.

ctx.x: Well, no, I'm going to be straight with you. I never did learn to read the music. I played, but you know what I mean, I never worried about music on a compliment, you see what I mean?
A lot of people were that great, like you said, but Mel San Diego couldn't read it all.
No, you know what I studied the whole lot was the chord system, you know? I studied the chord form. If you played in B-flat, well you know you'd have to make F, B-flat, you'd have to make E-flat.
